expected_symptom: DXIL for "void main(inout float4 pos : SV_Position) { pos.w = 1; }" at -T vs_6_0 writes output element 0 component 3 but not components 0/1/2 -- the unmodified xyz are not passed through from the input signature. Correct output: storeOutput for i8 0..3 with xyz fed by loadInput, and output signature Used=xyzw.
summary: Reproduces on main and on all 20 releases v1.4.1907..v1.9.2607. Writing one component of an inout signature element suppresses the pass-through of the rest: DXC emits only storeOutput(i32 5, i32 0, i32 0, i8 3, ...), no loadInput at all, and the output signature reads Used=w instead of xyzw. On SV_Position the DXIL validator catches it and the compile fails; on an ordinary varying (struct with TEXCOORD0) DXC exits 0 and silently emits a shader whose .yzw are undefined -- the impact evidence the 2024 dormancy note was missing. FXC passes all components through on the byte-identical sources.
title: Remainder of inout signature element not passed through when one component is modified
